summary: Phases 1-7 of Route P landed and committed, each individually build/lint/lean_verify-clean. Phase 4 added the ordered stepper (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered) plus its four structural lemmas. Phase 5 re-established the strict termination-measure decrease for the ordered stepper. Phase 6 (S4LoopInv preservation + fuel-sufficiency chain) landed ordered analogues of all TEN per-field sub-lemmas, TWO proof-internal auxiliaries, TWO additional prerequisite auxiliaries (branch_superset, keys_subset), and the final wrapper (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_S4LoopInv) across thirteen individually-committed dispatches. The escalation-trigger sub-lemma (keysDistinct, attempted first) PASSED with no weakening of keysUpdate_preserves_keysDistinct -- the plan's central claim (reordering only changes timing, never a duplicate key) is machine-checked. Phase 7 (Ordered Driver and Entry Point) is now COMPLETE: modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered and modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered landed as structural copies of the unordered pair with modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered substituted at the single processNext call site; Lean's termination checker accepted the copied fuel' recursion unchanged, with no termination_by/decreasing_by workaround needed. modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered seeds keys := [(0, ∅)] per the Phase 11 correction. Full CI pipeline green after Phase 7's commit: whole-project lake build (3256/3256, confirms FrameSoundness.lean/FrameCompleteness.lean still build), checkInitImports, lint-style, lake lint (one pre-existing unrelated error outside this task's scope), lake shake (zero import changes needed for LoopChecking.lean), lake test (9250/9250 including CslibTests.S4LoopGuardRegression). Repo-wide sorry count unchanged at 5, axiom count unchanged at 26.
decisions_made: Phase 4 deviation: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered's shared per-formula body is factored into a new NAMED definition (modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody) rather than duplicated inline as the phase-4 handoff had sketched. modalStepBranchS4Keyed's own source is byte-for-byte unchanged; the bridge modalStepBranchS4Keyed_eq_findSome_body (rfl) relates the two. This made the three required structural lemmas provable against a named term instead of restating a six-way match inline in every statement.

Phase 4 deviation: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_mintReady's hypothesis is phrased as '∀ sf, body sf = tuple → mintShape sf = true' (universally quantified over every formula that could have produced the exact output tuple) rather than a single externally-supplied selected formula, since no cheap uniqueness argument establishes that only one formula in b can produce a given output tuple. This is the airtight, general form; verified sound via the shared _cases case split.

Phase 5 discovery (see phase-6 handoff for full writeup): a `let (a,b):=f x; body` pattern-match compiles to direct `.1`/`.2` PROJECTIONS when `f` is an ABSTRACT parameter (as modalStepBranchGen's `apply` is) but to a full `match` when `f` is a CONCRETE, already-known function (as in modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody). This determines which of two rewriting idioms (`.1`-based rcases+rw, vs. rcases-pair+rw-at-hypothesis+re-derive-`.1`-facts-via-`have`) applies to a given hypothesis, and caused two rounds of build-error debugging before the correct idiom was identified. This WILL recur in every one of Phase 6's ten sub-lemmas.

Phase 5 discovery: `Option.some.inj h` (raw term) + a bare-name `obtain ⟨rfl, name, -⟩` pattern lets rcases's internal substitution unify a free `newExp`-shaped variable with a branch-specific value (e++[sf] for linear/branching, e itself for persistent) the rest of a measure/invariant proof needs; pre-simplifying via `simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h` first BLOCKS this unification and leaves the goal unsolvable. Matches the exact idiom the pre-existing (untouched) modalExpMeasure_step_lt_S4Keyed proof already relies on.

Phase 5's projection bridge (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_proj) intentionally does NOT assert the ordered stepper's result equals modalStepBranchGen's own whole-branch findSome? traversal at modalApplyOneS4Keyed φ₀ keys (that would be FALSE in general -- a different formula may genuinely be selected first, the entire point of reordering). It instead extracts the weaker existential fact the measure proof actually consumes: some sf ∈ b, sf ∉ e, whose rule application produces exactly the given result.
flagged_theorem_changes: Phase 14 ADDS modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_complete beside the landed modalTableauS4Keyed_complete (FrameCompleteness.lean); the landed theorem is not weakened. Not yet reached.

Phase 15 is the only destructive phase: it deletes modalStepBranchS4Keyed, modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed, modalTableauS4Keyed, modalTableauS4Keyed_complete and their stepper-specific support lemmas -- each with a proved ordered replacement. Removal-with-replacement, never weakening. Not yet reached.

Phase 6's escalation trigger (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_keysDistinct, attempted first per the handoff's recommendation) PASSED: keysUpdate_preserves_keysDistinct and blockingWorldS4Keyed_none_fresh are both consumed with their EXACT original signatures, no weakening. The plan's central claim -- reordering only changes timing, never producing a duplicate key -- is now machine-checked rather than assumed. No contradiction surfaced.

Phase 6 required TWO additional ordered-form auxiliaries not named in the plan text: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_branch_superset (prerequisite for keyLowerBd/keysWorldsKnown/worldsContiguousS4) and modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_keys_subset (prerequisite for keysTotal). Both are verbatim transcriptions of their unordered counterparts via modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_selected_mem, following the same case-split shape.

modalKnownWorlds_length_le_worldBoundS4/modalStepBranchS4_worldBound/modalExpMeasure_entry_le_fuelS4 all apply VERBATIM to the ordered driver with no ordered analogue needed: all three are stated purely over the pre-step b/keys or the entry-point modalUniverseS4 φ₀/modalFuelS4 φ₀, with no reference to which stepper (modalStepBranchS4Keyed vs. modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered) produced a given step. Confirmed, not assumed, per the plan's own instruction to prefer reuse and only re-derive if verbatim application genuinely fails.

No phase may discharge an obligation with sorry, an axiom, or a vacuous statement. Verified true of Phases 1-7: lean_verify on all new lemmas/defs reports only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, and the repo-wide bare `sorry` count in Cslib/ is unchanged at 5 throughout.

Phase 7 confirmed (not merely assumed) that the copied processNext fuel' recursion type-checks under Lean's own termination checker with zero changes to the recursion shape -- this is evidence against (not proof against) a termination gap at the driver-wiring level; the escalation concern remains formally live until Phase 8's empirical proof-search test and Phases 9-13's soundness/completeness re-derivation are complete.
dead_ends: Route Q (split accessibility record) is not planned: the research rejects it as strictly worse, reducing to Route P's step-2 obligation with extra bookkeeping.
No phase edits blockingWorldS4Keyed's comparison predicate; every local guard edit was refuted in research. Confirmed Phases 1-5 made zero edits to it beyond its Phase 2 docstring.

Phase 5's first attempt at modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_proj hand-typed a fresh let/match expression restating modalApplyOneS4Keyed's dispatch directly in the lemma's conclusion (mirroring modalStepBranchGen's shape textually). Abandoned: this elaborates via a full `match` (not projections, since the function is concrete at that elaboration site), breaking every subsequent `.1`-based rewrite the surrounding measure proof needed. Reusing the already-elaborated modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody (via Option.map to drop the keys' component) sidesteps the issue entirely -- this is now the established pattern for all future selection-agnostic bridge lemmas.
